summary: nextjsupdater fetches and executes a remote batch file from an unrelated personal GitHub repository
details: The package presents itself as an automatic updater for the Next.js framework but has no relationship to the Next.js publisher. Its exported downloadAndRunUpdate function constructs the URL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Acevatex/Testprogram/main/updater.bat, downloads the file to os.tmpdir(), and spawns cmd.exe /c on the downloaded bytes as a detached, unref'd child process. The source is a personal GitHub account unrelated to the package's declared purpose, the ref is a mutable main branch, and there is no hash or signature verification. Whoever controls Acevatex/Testprogram controls arbitrary code that executes on any Windows host where this function is invoked. The Next.js branding on a package published by a generic maintainer pointing at an unrelated personal repository is a cover-story pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
